integrity: The primary theorem is analytically proved with explicit coupling and moment identities; all finite checks are corroboration, not proof of the asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of equal-size patches, symmetric stochastic mixing, Markovian exponential recovery, and fixed strictly subcritical R; the first-order asymptotic is not uniform at criticality. Historical priority remains provisionally assessed.
title: A spectral finite-population correction for subcritical networked SIR outbreaks
